findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards the logger used to record log calls
findings.body: FromContext returns NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver (or a logger sharing the receiver's recorded state). LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so any test that constructs LoggerMiddleware with a TestLogger and asserts on that instance's InfoLogs will see zero calls because the message is recorded on a new, inaccessible TestLogger. The fake should return the receiver (f) so tests can observe logs emitted through FromContext.

findings.title: "Plugin Request Completed" logs lose the explicit traceID field
findings.body: logRequest previously added traceID (from tracing.TraceIDFromContext) to the log parameters, but that logic was removed and the replacement contextual attributes in ContextualLoggerMiddleware (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) do not include a trace ID. Unless infra/log.FromContext independently injects a trace ID, the completed-request log can no longer be correlated with traces by the traceID field that was present before this rename. The trace ID should be added to the contextual attributes or retained explicitly in logRequest.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger breaks existing implementations of the interface
findings.body: Logger is an interface, and this PR adds a required FromContext method to it. Only grafanaInfraLogWrapper and TestLogger in this repo's changed files are updated; any other implementations (other packages, generated/manual fakes, or downstream/enterprise code implementing plugins/log.Logger) will fail to compile until they add the method. This is a breaking interface change that should be called out and all in-tree implementations/fakes verified, or the method should be exposed via a separate optional interface.

findings.title: Renamed middleware test keeps old name and provides no coverage for moved contextual logging
findings.body: The test function is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware after the rename to MetricsMiddleware, and the PR adds a new ContextualLoggerMiddleware plus LoggerMiddleware's dependency on Logger.FromContext with no tests verifying that QueryData/CallResource/CheckHealth/CollectMetrics contexts carry endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname or that LoggerMiddleware emits those fields. Rename the test and add coverage for the new middleware and its interaction with LoggerMiddleware so the moved contextual-logger behavior cannot silently regress.
